rust_summary: a mod's own icons on filled maps (`native_map_decorations`).
doc_summary: `native_map_decorations(map, decorations)` is asked each time a map is drawn (held, in an item frame, or on the cartography table's screen) with `NativeMapInfo` (id, centre block, scale, dimension, locked, whether it is in a frame); push `NativeMapDecoration { sprite, x, y, rot, shown_on_frame }` (an atlas sprite, a position in half map pixels from -128 to 127, a rotation 0 to 15, and whether it shows in frames and on the screen like vanilla's markers) and it is drawn after the vanilla decorations with the same pose; a sprite the atlas lacks is left out. Nothing is saved in the map and vanilla's decorations are not passed in. This is the client half of NeoForge's `MapDecorationType`; types registered on the server and saved in map data need code-side registration. Bundles need "hooks": @API:map_decorations@.
